UNIT 2 · MOVEMENTS

Practice Exam · Unit 2 classroom rehearsal

Source-based short response or extended historical argument.

School-designed assessment preparation
Unit 2 only · adapted classroom practice

Schools determine Unit 2 assessment tasks, conditions and marking. This is not a QCAA external examination, a complete course paper or a prescribed Unit 2 instrument. The real Modern History EA directly assesses the selected Unit 4 topic/aspect. Use your teacher’s task sheet for source access, timing and permitted materials.

Set up a classroom rehearsal

The short clock (3 minutes planning + 24 working), extended clock (10 + 60), source counts and 18/12 marks are original classroom allocations. Choose untimed learning for research and drafting. They do not assert a statewide Unit 2 structure or reproduce Unit 3 IA1 conditions. Question/stimulus and response books help students practise evidence use, guided by published QCAA style.

Print a blank response book to practise handwriting. No external resources are needed to answer the bundled questions; your teacher determines whether notes or other materials are allowed in a real Unit 2 task. Each extract, digest, table and photograph is labelled. The original method-scenario option is an adapted reasoning exercise, not authentic historical stimulus.

Reopen an exact rehearsal

During timed practice, other revision screens are locked. Plan on the unmarked paper; responses unlock after planning. Skip, flag and return using the sidebar. The clock has no pause and continues through reload/closure. Submission or expiry locks responses and opens review. This is a self-managed rehearsal.

Build, share and personalise

Content and authenticity audit

Classification C: the original method bank covered the unit’s skills but substituted generic source descriptions for evidence students could interrogate. All 36 families / 108 variants are retained, including 36 MC keys, 72 written tasks and every response guide. Eighteen duplicated source pairs now have a distinct second source; no question or answer key was discarded.

Added: 12 families / 36 variants, making 48 families / 144 variants. Eighteen linked historical source cards include primary extracts, two embedded photographs, official results and archival tables, legislation and later interpretations. Three movement studies supplement the complete original labs, inquiry planner and school-assessment support. Simple and Complex Practice have distinct demands.

All 12 original prescribed topic options remain; the syllabus-permitted alternative topic is added. The First Nations course-selection rule is explicit. Other movement topics retain the original fictional method exercises: these are not a substitute for authentic class records. No AI feedback/export is enabled.

Changing topics or focus archives Unit 2 ratings, drafts, notes, teacher sets, planner and workshops. v2 storage is untouched. Legacy family-level check counts are retained without inventing which variant was checked; missing v2 MC selections cannot be recovered. New selections are saved per variant.

Class topics and v2 migration

Your school selects two Unit 2 movements. Name the focus actually studied. Changing topics or focus archives previous work and restores it if you switch back. The alternative option needs a teacher-approved movement named in its focus field.

Bring forward your v2 work

The original v2 storage is left untouched. Import ratings, drafts, class topics, planner and sets from this browser or a v2 JSON backup. Existing v3 data takes priority when the same variant already has a record. Browser file-origin storage may differ between filenames: export a backup from the old file when needed. New Unit 2 skills rehearsals use their own Unit 2 key and are included in the backup.

Uses the visible filters. The same filters, profile, count, seed and class settings produce the same set. The portable code fixes exact IDs and class settings.

The portable code includes the selected class topics. Original MH25U2 codes and comma-separated IDs remain supported; original codes use the class topics currently selected.

Progress and backups

Back up question ratings and drafts before clearing browser data or changing devices. Downloading an app does not export student work.
